name: autotour
description: Create modular walkthroughs and product documentation from web applications.

interface.longDescription: Explore a web application with Playwright and produce maintainable walkthrough manifests, screenshots, DOM replay, and video outputs.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me plan a product clip, HTML DOM tour, or visual how-to for this web application. Before creating, capturing, exporting, or publishing anything, ask for the audience, exact task or journey, application URL/environment, permitted access, destination and format, and any relevant duration, cursor, zoom, or motion choices. Treat requests for Word or other office documents as incomplete until the content scope is confirmed.
